notes:
- The build stamp cannot sit on a row: The version line was the last child of the shelf and also of the crossfade that swaps the shelf for search results. With no size transform that container lays the outgoing mode out at the incoming one's height, which is how the stamp was drawn across "Device Manager" in the 2.5.4 screenshot. It is a sibling of the crossfade now, drawn only while the shelf is showing and clipped with the list it sits under.
- The type sample stays inside its card: The size preview is scaled in the draw phase so dragging does not reflow the paragraph, but that also left its layout at 100%: at 125% and above the last line drew over the slider. The card reserves the scaled height now, in 8dp steps so a drag does not re-measure it on every tick.
- Reset on Seasonal effects resets the thumbs: Reset wrote the stored defaults but the sliders are drafts keyed on the committed value, so a value that was already the default - or a thumb dragged without committing - kept its old number while the sky reset. Reset seeds every draft as well as the store.
- Refining a search starts at the best answer: Scrolling to the top was keyed on entering search mode, so typing a second word while scrolled through the first answer left the reader at that offset and the best matches above the viewport. Every query change returns to the top; the mode change keeps its spring, a refined query snaps.
- Downloaded font families are read off the main thread: The list of stored families is a directory walk plus a name decode per family, and its comment already said it ran on the IO dispatcher. It did not - it ran in the frame that draws the page. It is dispatched now.
- A GIF key is saved to the field it was typed into: Save ran in a coroutine that read the selected provider when it resumed, so switching chips mid-save filed the key under whichever provider was selected by then. The provider is captured with the editor.
- A selected chip no longer nudges its row: The chip's border animated from 1dp to 2dp, which changes its measured size, so choosing one pill pushed every pill after it along the row. The border is a constant 1.5dp and the colour carries the selection, the way the appearance tiles already work.
- A row's value crossfades where it sits: The value is end-aligned on the row, but its AnimatedContent was start-aligned, so a change drew the old value against the left edge of the new value's width before it faded. The transition is end-aligned too.
- Back dismisses the search keyboard first: With the caret in the search field and a blank query, Back fell through to the screen's handler and closed Settings. The field now consumes Back while it has focus and only drops the keyboard.
- The Search tab switch admits when it cannot be honoured: The bar hides Search when both catalogue halves are off, while the switch above kept reading "on". It is disabled with the reason when there is no page for the bar to add.
- Controls settle with the theme instead of after it: Eleven selection transitions - the tab bar, both segmented bars, the state chip, the navigation bar and the appearance tiles - animated a colour spring toward a scheme role. The scheme animates every role on every frame of a theme change, so those targets never settled and the control arrived a beat after its page. They animate one progress and read both endpoints live, the pattern rememberStateColor already documents.
- Reset card design resets the whole group: The button wrote only the frame, proportions, corners and type scales. The card style and the poster source are part of the same group and kept their values, and when those were the only changes the button was disabled - a reset that could not reset. It now clears all three and is enabled for either.
- A palette or hue pick beats the kept cover colour: Both pickers released the live anime layer and the wallpaper, but not the retained cover colour, which outranks a palette and a custom hue in Theme.kt. The tap was stored and the app kept drawing the kept tint; the pick now releases it too.
- Retain anime colour says when it has nothing to keep: The switch could be on while Anime dynamic theme was off, so no sheet ever borrowed a colour for it to retain. It is disabled with that reason, but off is always allowed - a stored on can never be trapped behind a disabled switch - and the tint and revert pickers explain what turns them on instead of only being dimmed.
- Saved on the Client ID means saved: "Use default" put the field back to a value that had not been saved while the button kept its Saved label and check. The label is now derived from the field matching the stored id, not from a latch.
- An app lock can always be turned off: If the screen lock the app lock relied on was removed, the switch drew itself checked and disabled with no way to clear it - and it would lock again as soon as a lock was set. Off is allowed without a device credential; on still needs one.
- The sample bottom bar is a picture: The preview passed an empty select callback but the tabs still pressed, rippled and announced themselves as buttons for taps that could not navigate. The bar takes an interactive flag and the sample turns it off.
- Search suggestions announce themselves as actions: They were FilterChips, which a screen reader reports as unselected toggles that never become selected. They are suggestion chips now.
- The cover cache clears off the click frame: Clearing it ran Coil's disk-cache delete on the main thread in both places that offer it, freezing the page while the files went. Both now dispatch the clear to IO; the Device Manager figure updates when it returns.
- The Updates page no longer reads its notes in composition: The changelog asset was opened and parsed during the page's first frame. It loads on IO now, with a reading line in place of the "no notes" copy that used to flash before the file was read.
- Disabled pickers say what enables them: The Continue Watching rail, the retained-tint picker and the revert picker were dimmed without a sentence, which reads as a setting that broke rather than one waiting for the switch above. Each names its dependency now.
- Every Settings target is at least 48dp: The connection chip was 34, Show more 36, the hue chips 44 and the saved-line actions, canvas chips and mock-card buttons 32 to 38. They are 48 now, without changing the shapes they draw.
- Credits draw their edges and dividers: The developer card's border was a 38% outlineVariant - about 1.3:1 in the light scheme - and the helper dividers and chevron sat under their contrast floors. They use the emphasis boundary, divider and muted roles.
- The empty search state is legible: Its glyph was tinted with the caption colour at 70% alpha, about 2.5:1 on the page. It uses the muted role that clears 3:1.
- The theme preview stops chasing the theme: The mock card's Plan and Watch buttons animated four colours toward scheme roles, so on a theme change each re-targeted every frame and landed after the card. They animate the decision and read both endpoints live, like the tab bar.
- Palette and hue selection settle with the theme too: The palette card's border and the hue chip's ring had the same re-targeting problem: one endpoint was a scheme role, so a theme change restarted the spring every frame. Both animate one progress over live roles.
Build 690.
